overview: Tracify is an industrial-grade traceability app for food manufacturing. It tracks batches from raw materials through production with 3 interconnected log books, role-based access for supervisors and operators, audit trails, and printable compliance reports.
features: Backward traceability: type a batch code to see all raw materials and lot numbers used
Forward traceability: type a lot number to see all batches it appeared in
Packing Log, Tank Room Log, and Raw Materials log books with full CRUD
User login with supervisor and operator roles
Audit trail on every record showing who created or edited it
Date-range filters on all log books
Mandatory field validation to prevent incomplete records
Printable PDF traceability reports for compliance audits
